title: Foolproof Juicy Chicken Prep Technique
instructions: Heat a thick, heat-retaining skillet (creator uses a Ninja Kitchen Everclad) over medium heat — use higher heat if your pan doesn't retain heat as well.
Cook/sear the chicken using this technique (full step-by-step is only shown in the video, not written out).
Creator notes results are better if you remove the pan from the burner ('the eye') and let the chicken sit/rest rather than leaving it on direct heat.
notes: Partial — video only. This is a chicken-cooking technique reel, not a full recipe with a printed ingredient list. Caption credits the technique to 'Organic Kitchen' and another creator, 'Smalltownfluencer', who reportedly invented it. Commenters suggested variations: use chicken broth instead of water for flavor, add bone broth after browning, use 1/2 cup dry white wine instead, and start with a hot pan + cold oil so food doesn't stick.
